title: PI returns full binary64 pi (0x400921fb54442d18), 7 ULPs above the documented 15-digit decimal
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, PI() returns the nearest binary64 value to pi, 0x400921fb54442d18 (3.141592653589793), which is 7 representable steps above the 15-significant-digit decimal 3.14159265358979 (0x400921fb54442d11). This worksheet constant is distinct from the 64-bit x87 FLDPI constant used inside SIN, COS, and TAN range reduction.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0 build 20430 (2/2 full-bank and 1/1 pinned PI rows) and 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 182).

documentation.claim: Returns the number 3.14159265358979, the mathematical constant pi, accurate to 15 digits.
